_help: Phase 7 sites. YOU fill in the blank fields BEFORE running run_regions.py. The runner refuses a site until they are filled.
The coordinates were checked by the user on the satellite view on 2026-10-13 (start points came from Gemini and Claude, and several were corrected). Write land_type yourself, from what you see.
lat and lon are only MY approximate starting points. Open each on the satellite view, move the pin to the land type in 'intended', paste the real 'lat, lon' here, then set verified to true.
land_type: what you actually see at the point (for example 'bare sandy soil with sparse shrubs').
expect_gate: none, warning or blocked. Your blind expectation of the eligibility gate.
expect_warning_contains: optional word a warning should contain, for example cropland or built-up.
expect_plants: plants you expect to be offered (any tier). expect_ruled_out: plants you expect to be ruled out. expect_not_strong: plants you would be unhappy to see as Strong fit.
Plant names as in plants.csv (for example Khejri, Babul, Teak, Sissoo, Bamboo, Salai).
Commit this file before the first run: the commit time proves your expectations came first.

Provenance: the expectations for all ten sites were drafted by Claude from general knowledge (not from the gate rules and before any result existed) and accepted unchanged by the user on 2026-10-13. Land types are the user's confirmed observations.

status: accepted = the system's behaviour is accepted and test_regions.py requires the expectations to match; known_issue = the system is wrong in a documented way and test_regions.py requires the miss to persist (so a fix shows up); pending = no verdict yet. original_expectation holds the blind expectations as committed before the first run; the fields above them were corrected after the review (see 'review').

Round 2 (v2.0.0, 2026-10-23): 12 more sites, listed after the first ten. Candidates came from Gemini; on 2026-10-23 the user checked each point on the satellite view and accepted the expectations, which Claude had drafted before any run (see notes on each site). Status stays pending until the first run is reviewed.
